name: Southern Vermont Arts Center Summer Camps
description_short: Summer art camps for children and teens at the Southern Vermont Arts Center in Manchester, VT, split into age groups: PreK to Kindergarten, Grades 1 to 3, Grades 4 to 6 and Grades 7 to 12. Camps often fill quickly.
refund_policy_summary: Refund requests are charged a 50% fee.
